commit_title: Add subplot axis sync controls and matching
commit_message: Introduces `syncXAxis` and `syncYAxis` state in the subplot side menu store, exposes new toggle switches in `SubplotSideMenu`, and wires those settings into `generatePlotConfig`. When enabled, secondary subplots now set Plotly `matches` (`x`/`y`) to synchronize axis scales across the grid, while preserving existing title behavior and disabling sync controls for a single-plot layout.
